BiblicalUsage: Machi was the father of Geuel, named once, in Numbers 13:15, where Geuel the son of Machi is listed among the spies sent from the tribe of Gad. His son Geuel was one of the twelve spies sent from the tribe of Gad, and Machi's name goes with him into the record.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Machi is remembered for his son's mission: Geuel went into the land, and his father's name went with him.
